procedures.name: MongoDB Atlas data-loss recovery
currentTierProcedure: Quiesce application writes before any free-tier logical backup.
Confirm active GridFS uploads are zero.
Create mongodump outside the Git repository using scripts/backupMongoFreeTier.ps1.
Restore only into an isolated non-production target.
Run BackupRestoreVerificationService and GridFS integrity/SHA checks.
procedures.commercialProductionGap: Continuous cloud backup and PITR remain unavailable while Atlas is FREE.

procedures.name: Render backend recovery
procedure: Recover the stateless backend from the authoritative main branch.
Verify GridFS-backed documents remain independent of Render local filesystem.

procedures.name: Frontend/Vercel recovery
procedure: Rebuild the zero-build frontend from the authoritative main branch.
Verify router imports and frontend secret scan.
Use local PWA/offline shell only as a temporary continuity measure.
Commercial Vercel account/project authorization remains governed by EXT-10.

procedures.name: GitHub release pipeline recovery
procedure: Do not bypass release governance while GitHub checks are unavailable.
Preserve the last known-good SHA and deployment IDs.
Resume normal protected-branch workflow when GitHub service recovers.

procedures.name: ClamAV outage handling
procedure: Fail closed for new document promotion.
Keep unverified uploads quarantined and non-downloadable.
Do not send documents to public third-party scanners.
Resume reconciliation only after private scanner health and signature freshness recover.

procedures.name: Email provider outage
procedure: Preserve generic password-recovery responses to prevent account enumeration.

externalBlockers.reason: Continuous cloud backup and point-in-time recovery require a supported Atlas paid tier.
Independent secondary/offsite backup storage target and restore evidence are not configured.
